title: PATCH /report-subscriptions/{id} – request
description: Change the frequency of a subscription; an existing (user_id, site_id, frequency) is 409 conflict. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/report-subscription.response.json.
